description: Acceptance criteria v3: v2 UNCHANGED plus the issue #2 finalisation scenarios (NUSB-0/1/2, T7, R5-RELOAD/UNPLUG/RESTART, G9, M2, H10, U8). Written BEFORE any run of these scenarios; pin its sha256 with --criteria-sha256. v1 (2dfc47e2...760760c) and v2 (57fa046e...a43e) stay valid and are never edited. The comparator is unchanged in spirit: the new scenarios only use data-driven checks over raw files.

requirements.text: Complete destructive cycle through Campaign/Orchestrator: verified backups, programming, independent readback, restoration, final compare, clean close
A grant that expires naturally cannot be re-armed; the owner can still disarm; no grant is re-created
A local revocation is distinguished from an expiry and has the same consequences
Ownership: a new reservation or another identity cannot disarm a trigger, with a VALID grant (not a grant refusal)
Coordinated server restart at rest: ordered stop/start, new epoch, same durable journal, agent reconnects without replay, fresh proof window
Read-only identification, repeatable reads and partition table of a C3, with declared transport and agent inference both recorded
One explicit reset with observation of the ROM banner in the same proof window
S3 behind an external UART bridge: one EN reset and the ROM banner in the same proof window (issue #2, requirement 1)
S3 behind an external UART bridge: one atomic boot.download (IO0 + EN), grant natural expiry, download-mode marker in the same window (issue #2, requirement 1; the wiring is an assumption)
S3 behind an external UART bridge: console reopened after a settled loader read, shown by a transport event (transport proof only)
Multi-image programming under a real manifest: one multi-image write, per-region backups, restoration and comparison, control windows unchanged where they look (issue #2, requirement 4)

Native USB Serial/JTAG (never an external bridge or USB OTG): identity, refusal of EN/BOOT commands, repeatable reads and one valid table, one explicit reset with the restart shown by a banner or an observed re-enumeration (issue #2, requirement 2)
UART trigger fired by a controlled stimulus: fires once, deferred reset after the delay, re-arming cancels a pending action (issue #2, requirement 7)
Interruption during a read (tab reload, USB unplug, server restart): never replayed, indeterminate outcomes keep the card blocked until the operator's local recovery (issue #2, requirements 5 and 6)
A reservation expires by itself and the expired handle is refused (issue #2, requirement 9)
Two cards of the same family reserved together and released independently (issue #2, requirement 9)
HTTP to a LAN target through the agent: one listed origin, opaque response, redirects refused, no credentials, other origins / https / credentials refused (issue #2, requirement 10)
Sustained UART capture seen by an external archiving client: no silent loss, no duplicate, losses announced, resume at the cursor (issue #2, requirement 8)

not_covered.text: Resistance to interruptions and faults (USB/power cut, browser/server loss during a write): NOT qualified
Endurance and statistical repeatability beyond the planned passes: NOT qualified
Behaviour of a consumer firmware, application boot (boot_verified is always false by design), OTA: out of the bench scope
R4 control windows detect a change only where they look; the integrity of the whole flash is NOT demonstrated
A fault during a flash WRITE (cut, unplug, restart) is NOT qualified: it needs its own authorisation, verified backups and a validated recovery procedure
USB OTG mode is NOT qualified; only USB Serial/JTAG is covered by NUSB-*
No deterministic ACK / result loss injection exists; loss is observed only through the natural faults of R5-*
The background state of the page during U8 is an announced gesture, not a verified condition
Locking / concurrency of the deferred reset with other commands is covered by engine tests only
